related_questions.question: What is the most accurate rapid Covid test?
related_questions.snippet: There are two types of rapid COVID-19 test available — molecular and antigen. You can do both of these at home or with a healthcare professional. The most accurate rapid test is the molecular COVID test. But rapid antigen tests may be more widely available, and they still provide useful results.

related_questions.question: What are the different COVID tests available?
related_questions.snippet: There are two common types of COVID-19 diagnostic tests: Molecular tests, such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and other nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) tests, which detect genetic material called RNA from the virus.

related_questions.question: Are home COVID tests still accurate?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, home COVID tests are still considered accurate, particularly when used correctly and when symptoms are present. While they may be less sensitive than laboratory-based PCR tests, especially for detecting early or asymptomatic infections, positive results from at-home antigen tests are generally reliable. To increase accuracy, especially with negative results, repeat testing is often recommended.

list.title: Accuracy of Negative Results:

list.title: Importance of Repeat Testing:
